maddeler.e:
أتحاش (form VI)
# أَتَحَاشَ (ʔataḥāša) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# أُتَحَاشَ (ʔutaḥāša) /ʔu.ta.ħaː.ʃa/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
